001
002package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node;
003
004import dev.metaschema.core.model.IDefinition;
005import dev.metaschema.core.model.IModelDefinition;
006import dev.metaschema.core.model.INamedInstance;
007import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
008
009/**
010 * A base implementation of a node item backed by a Metaschema instance.
011 *
012 * @param <D>
013 *          the Java type of the definition
014 * @param <I>
015 *          the Java type of the instance
016 * @param <P>
017 *          the Java type of the parent node item
018 */
019public abstract class AbstractInstanceNodeItem<
020    D extends IDefinition,
021    I extends INamedInstance,
022    P extends IModelNodeItem<? extends IModelDefinition, ? extends INamedInstance>>
023    extends AbstractNodeItem
024    implements IDefinitionNodeItem<D, I> {
025
026  @NonNull
027  private final I instance;
028  @NonNull
029  private final P parent;
030
031  /**
032   * Construct a new instance node item.
033   *
034   * @param instance
035   *          the Metaschema instance this node represents
036   * @param parent
037   *          the parent node item containing this instance
038   */
039  public AbstractInstanceNodeItem(
040      @NonNull I instance,
041      @NonNull P parent) {
042    this.instance = instance;
043    this.parent = parent;
044  }
045
046  @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
047  @Override
048  public D getDefinition() {
049    return (D) getInstance().getDefinition();
050  }
051
052  @Override
053  public I getInstance() {
054    return instance;
055  }
056
057  @Override
058  public P getParentNodeItem() {
059    return parent;
060  }
061
062  @Override
063  public P getParentContentNodeItem() {
064    return getParentNodeItem();
065  }
066}
